entry_points.text: Driver extension points comprise pinctrl group/mapping ops, platform probe/remove/power hooks, PnP protocol resource and power callbacks, PR per-device ops, PPS echo, and namespace acquire/release/install/owner operations.
Property accessors read single u32 values and probe counts for devices and firmware nodes, including string-array population, with device forms delegating to the firmware node.

exports.text: Pin config device-tree parsing offers group, pin, and auto-infer wrappers over a common mapper; controller lookup returns null when unsupported.
Platform device creation, driver registration, drvdata access, and SCU IPC register/command helpers capture caller identity and delegate to core routines.
With PnP disabled, attach/start/stop/activate/disable/register report missing, lookups yield null, active is false, and resource helpers return defaults; a macro wires module registration.
ACL fallback chmod succeeds while set/get fail unsupported; firmware helpers test compat, iterate parents/children with scoped variants, and match connections via callback.
With profiling disabled, init succeeds, tick/hit recorders discard input, and the enable flag reads zero.

hazards.text: In the fallback build, managed platform mapping by index or name yields an invalid-argument error pointer, and PnP possible-config reports zero success while active tests report false, so callers must validate before use.
Spin-until-condition busy-waits with relaxation and no timeout or sleep, so callers must guarantee the condition becomes true and spinning is legal.

invariants.text: Pin config packs selector in low 8 bits with 24-bit argument; without pkeys only key zero exists and allocation fails; platform suspend hook is null and SH early test is false.

PnP capability checks gate read/write/disable/configure on bits plus callbacks and active policy; protocol identity compares pointers and exposes card numbers; ACL dup/release use refcount with deferred free; PPS sampling copies real and optional raw time.

Prefetch strides by cache line and no-ops without support; spin relax maps to CPU relax; profile hit forwards only on enable match; projid compares raw values with invalid/overflow rules; fwnode put/count delegate and endpoints require a remote marker.

Property array builders store count times width with external pointer, singletons inline values, bool sets name only, refs store a record pointer; PSCI init reports success while present/hvc report false.
Time conversion, timestamp subtraction, refcount increment/decrement-test, and RCU deferred free are supplied by other dossiers.

locks.text: PPS event state is serialized by a device spinlock coordinating sequence counters, timestamps, wait queue, and async notification.

state_machines.text: Pin control clients move among default, init, idle, and sleep across setup, active use, idling, and suspend.
Platform devices advance from registration through probe to active use with optional suspend/resume and poweroff cycles ending in remove or shutdown.
PnP devices combine a readiness code with device state including an active flag; SEV firmware advances uninitialized to initialized to working.

structs.text: Pin groups bind name to pin arrays, pin descriptors bind id to name and private data, GPIO ranges link numbering domains, controller descriptions aggregate tables and ops, and functions bind name to groups.

Platform devices combine name/id, embedded device, DMA data, resources, and table links; creation info bundles parent/nodes/resources/data; NAND, simplefb, and SCU IPC data carry their setup parameters.
PnP cards, devices, links, identifiers, drivers, and protocols carry list nodes, identity, resources, and callbacks with conversions and global/per-card/per-protocol iteration.

Generic pin params end at 0x7F with 0xFF ceiling; four state keys exist; GPIO flag is bit zero; platform IDs use -1/-2; PnP names allow 50 chars; FCH decode-enable offset and PnP config/capability/state codes use stated values.
Poison pointers derive list, timer, BPF, VFS, io_uring and other markers from a base plus fixed offsets; poison bytes use stated per-subsystem fills for pages, slabs, ATM, mutex, and keys.

ACL lists use refcount with flexible entries and xattr count/name helpers; PPS source/event/device track modes, timestamps, sequences, and queues; PR keys/reservations use flexible arrays; RNG holds four words with folded seeding; namespace ops hold callbacks with an allocator.

Profiling uses bits 1/2/4; projid wraps u32 with invalid/overflow markers; property nodes carry types, ref args, entries, and static links with graph flags in low bits; PSCI defines standby 0/down 1 with ops table and legacy IDs; pseudo-fs holds ops and magic; SEV/SNP policies use stated masks with 16KiB blob cap.
